archetype: 3 card-deck — a deck of file-size cards in the y>=606 band starts as a pile of red rejected downloads and flips, one card at a time, to a green delivered stack; by the final beat the whole deck reads delivered
notes: RE-SHOOT of an existing clip: narration/timing kept exactly (B1=15,B2=200,B3=383,B4=539,B5=741,END=874), only the picture is rebuilt. Previous build of THIS archetype (p20) is the documented failure case: a 180px corner pile while a centered headline and big number owned the screen. Fix here: the deck is a full-width labeled band (x=40,y=606,w=1200,h=92, same footprint as d09's ledger) that is the thing the beat is about, not a decoration — every card carries its real size and a red/green status stamp, and it changes state in every beat. Recent openers to avoid: titleTakeover (d08), funnelAbsorption (p78), keywordCaption (d04) — b1 opens with targetOverrun instead. Only commit given (0ad86a2, 'integrate MTKruto for Telegram video downloads') is shown once, in b3, zoomed on the real client-init hunk, because that is the only beat whose sentence ('a client with MTKruto that logs in like a real user, not a bot') matches the commit message.

beats.description: Real commit 0ad86a2 ('feat: integrate MTKruto for Telegram video downloads (bypass 20MB limit)') shown via a custom LiveWindow box that ends above y=606 (clear of the deck band), zoomed on the client-init hunk: 'const client = new Client({ apiId, apiHash }); await client.start({ botToken });'. One tech gloss caption here: 'MTProto - Telegram's own client protocol, not the limited Bot API'.

All 4 cards flip red->green one by one (scaleY squish, no spring): 61MB/182MB/340MB/512MB DELIVERED; a 5th card arrives already green: 2.1GB DOCUMENTARY DELIVERED; badge reads '5 delivered / 0 dropped'

Hero '100%' + caption 'Video failures: gone', LogWindow with 6 real lines built from the feature's own numbers (6 channels, 20MB Bot API limit, MTProto client online, 2GB new cap, 50MB-2GB+ ingestion range, 100% of 'video too large' failures eliminated).
